terms.definitionEn: A method that calls a callback for each item and returns a new array of results.
terms.definitionAr: ميثود بتشغّل دالة على كل عنصر وبتطلع مجموعة جديدة بالنتايج.

terms.definitionEn: A method that returns a new array containing items whose callback result is truthy.
terms.definitionAr: ميثود بترجع مجموعة جديدة فيها العناصر اللي نتيجة فحصها ناجحة.

terms.definitionEn: A method that combines array items into one accumulated result.
terms.definitionAr: ميثود بتجمع عناصر المجموعة تدريجيًا في نتيجة واحدة.

terms.definitionEn: A method that returns the first item satisfying a callback condition.
terms.definitionAr: ميثود بترجع أول عنصر يحقق الشرط اللي بتفحصه الدالة.

terms.definitionEn: A method that checks whether at least one item satisfies a callback condition.
terms.definitionAr: ميثود بتفحص إذا كان عنصر واحد على الأقل بيحقق الشرط.

terms.definitionEn: A method that checks whether each item satisfies a callback condition.
terms.definitionAr: ميثود بتتأكد إن كل العناصر بتحقق الشرط المطلوب.

terms.definitionEn: A function passed to an operation for it to invoke while processing values.
terms.definitionAr: دالة بتتبعت لعملية تانية عشان تناديها وهي بتعالج القيم.

terms.definitionEn: A function that tells a sorting operation the relative order of two values.
terms.definitionAr: دالة بتحدد ترتيب قيمتين بالنسبة لبعض أثناء الفرز.

terms.definitionEn: An ordering based on comparing text-like representations from left to right.
terms.definitionAr: ترتيب بيعتمد على مقارنة تمثيل القيم كنص من الشمال لليمين.

terms.definitionEn: The running value passed from one reduction step to the next.
terms.definitionAr: النتيجة الحالية اللي بتتنقل من خطوة جمع للخطوة اللي بعدها.

terms.definitionEn: A callback that determines whether a value meets a condition.
terms.definitionAr: دالة بتحدد إذا كانت قيمة معينة بتحقق شرط ولا لأ.

terms.definitionEn: An operation that returns a result without changing the original collection.
terms.definitionAr: عملية بترجع نتيجة جديدة من غير ما تغيّر المجموعة الأصلية.

options: A new array containing each callback result
The first item that passes a test

The callback adds one to each input element.
filter keeps the values whose even-number predicate is true.

questions.question: Which items are kept by filter?
options: Every item transformed by the callback
Items whose callback result is a number
Items whose callback result is truthy

questions.explanation: map applies the transformation once to each value.

options: Whether at least one item satisfies the predicate
A new array of matching items, with one result for every original element regardless of the predicate
The first item that satisfies the predicate
Whether every item satisfies the predicate
questions.explanation: some answers a yes/no question about at least one matching value.

questions.question: Why can the default sort order be surprising for numbers?
options: Values are compared as strings by default
The array is copied before sorting
questions.explanation: Without a comparator, sort orders string representations lexicographically.
The numeric comparator orders the values from smallest to largest in place.

questions.prompt: Fill the comparator result for ascending numeric order.
questions.explanation: Returning a - b places smaller numbers before larger numbers.

questions.prompt: Write sortedCopy(values), returning numeric ascending order without changing values.
questions.explanation: Copy before calling the mutating sort method and provide a numeric comparator.
Without an initial value, reduce uses the first element as the starting accumulator.

questions.question: How do map and forEach differ in their typical result?
keyPoints: map returns a new array of callback results
questions.modelAnswer: map applies a callback and returns a new array containing its results. forEach is generally used to perform side effects for each value and does not return a transformed array.

questions.question: Why is an initial value often useful with reduce?
keyPoints: It defines the accumulator's starting value
It gives the empty-array case a result
It avoids consuming the first element as the initial accumulator
Choose an identity appropriate to the operation
questions.modelAnswer: An initial value defines what the accumulator starts with and what result an empty array should produce. For addition, zero is a natural identity; for multiplication, one is.

questions.question: What should you consider when sorting numbers with Array.prototype.sort?
keyPoints: Copy first when the original order must remain
questions.modelAnswer: The default sort compares string representations, so numbers may not appear in numeric order. Supply a comparator such as (a, b) => a - b, and copy the array first if you need to preserve the original.
